messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a case where a streaming session got soft-trim during an internal model-swap and the invoice shows both a provisional stream charge and a confirmed toolcall charge. double-bill.
helen: ugh. do you have ids?
maria: sess=SE-9001 trace=tr-20260328-xx. router swapped snapshot mid-stream. provisional created on old snapshot, confirmed on new q4.
raj.k: SDK behavior matters — client reconnected and created a fresh toolcall with no idempotency key, so reconciler couldn't match.
sam_g: reconciler currently requires either resume_token OR identical model_id. swaps break that.
helen: short-term: prioritise resume_token/idempotency_key even if model differs. long-term: mark provisional created_during_swap and allow auto-adjust if final amount < provisional.
billing-bot: BI-4201 created: "provisional-swap-reconcile".
console-ui: we'll add a small timeline flag and show "provisional (swap) -> reconciled" state for enterprise exports.
maria: router change: can we add X-Inflight-Session header and X-Internal-Swap:true so provisional items carry context?
raj.k: yep, router patch is small. but third-party clients might not preserve headers on reconnect. SDK patch needed to keep idempotency on reconnect.
sam_g: metrics: provisional_swap_count, recon_rate, manual_review_rate. alert if provisional_swap_count spikes.
helen: plan: (1) reconciler heuristic tweak (priority on resume_token) — 1w (2) router header canary to infra accounts — 3 days (3) SDK patch preserve idempotency on resume — 1w (4) console timeline + export — 2w.
maria: i'll surface to finance for refund policy. raj.k will own router, helen reconciler, console-ui will mockup.
helen: add unit tests for model-mismatch but resume_token match, and some abuse cases.
maria: repro snippet added to BI ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:
